problem.equation: u_t + v dot grad_x(u) = 0 on R^d
problem.active_directions_are: q1 is a leading high-variance direction; q4 lies below the 99%-variance PCA cutoff.
problem.pca_scope: Centered coordinate PCA is fit on training coordinates only; JAX autodiff propagates through each fixed linear projection.
problem.sampling: The base and PCA models share the same spatial samples, time partitions, supervised batches, initial-condition points, and PDE residual points per seed.
